name: Andi Ahmad Nurmadani
tagline: Building systems, writing code, and keeping servers alive.
about: I run Linux servers, NAS boxes and self-hosted services, and build the tools I wish I had while doing it.
Most of what I make ends up open source: an SSH client for Android, a monitoring dashboard, and a small Postgres backend platform.

featured.title: TermX
featured.blurb: SSH client for Android with persistent tmux sessions, auto-reconnect, SFTP and a live server monitor.

featured.title: Kroombox Monitoring
featured.blurb: Self-hosted dashboard for websites, servers and NAS, with retries before alerts and one-click updates.

featured.title: KroomBase
featured.blurb: Postgres per project, a REST endpoint for every table, file storage and an MCP server for AI tools.
